notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
